- `desktop/macos/acceptance/**` — acceptance fixtures — test data in document form
- `.github/secret-scan-allowlist.txt` — scanner configuration, not a document
- `docs/backlog/**` — dated data snapshots (JSON), not documents; DELETE class (d) at execution
- `docs/doc-registry.json` — the registry itself
- `docs/doc-registry.md` — the generated registry view
